_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Simulation Paper. Proposes PSS-PPM (Pulse Sequence Sensing + Pulse Position Modulation) for FSO-ISAC. Detailed numerical analysis for concurrent communication and sensing.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Figure 1: System model for FSO-ISAC using PSS-PPM. Figure 2: Signal structure (Slots with PPM and Guard Intervals). Figures 3-5: Numerical results (Rate, BER, RMSE).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: FSO ISAC. Modulation: Pulse Position Modulation (PPM) for data + Embedded Pulse Sequences (PSS) for sensing. Detection: IM/DD. Sensing Algorithm: Cross-correlation + Quadratic Fitting.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: Achievable rates ~1-3.5 Mbps (low rate, pulse based). BER 10^-4 at -12 dB SNR. Sensing: RMSE approaches CRB (~1 cm) at high SNR. Resolution ~7.5 cm (sampling limited) improved by fitting.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Novel integration of PPM and sensing sequences for simple IM/DD FSO systems. Addresses Multi-User Interference (MUI).

bibliographic.title: Pulse Sequence Sensing and Pulse Position Modulation for Optical Integrated Sensing and Communication
bibliographic.authors: Yunfeng Wen, Fang Yang, Jian Song, Zhu Han

application.scenario_description: FSO laser radar providing simultaneous communication and ranging (e.g., V2V or autonomous driving).

key_contribution.key_contribution: Proposed PSS-PPM scheme for simultaneous FSO communication and sensing with unipolar signals.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Providing simultaneous sensing and communication for IM/DD optical systems with high power efficiency.

receiver.notes: IM/DD. Matched filter for PN code.

integration.notes: Simultaneous Comm and Sensing in same slot structure.

waveform.notes: PN code sequence (m-sequence) embedded in PPM signal.

channel_wireless.notes: Modeled with atmospheric losses and turbulence (Rytov variance 0.04).

comm_metrics.notes: ~3 Mbps achievable rate. Low rate due to pulse structure.

sensing_metrics.notes: Unambiguous range 300m. RMSE ~1cm with quadratic fitting.

tradeoff.notes: Fig 3 shows tradeoff: Higher sequence length L (better sensing) -> Lower Data Rate.
